notes.title: Dungeons & Drivers Changelog v0.1.38
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340358/599943f5536d1a529923acdca9321506b8965d38.png[/img]

[b]Balance Changes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Attributes scale with level
[*] Deaths do not penalize the match score
[*] Revive area is bigger and revive time is reduced
[*] Game difficulty adjusts when a player disconnects from the match
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]

[list]
[*] The car will no longer keep moving after death
[*] "Join match" on Steam now works from any menu on the start screen
[*] Fixed bug that prevented connecting to another player's lobby
[*] Fixed bug that could freeze the upgrade selection screen
[*] Fixed bug that allowed enemies to enter structures
[*] Fixed bug that allowed players to exit the map
[*] Fixed bug that allowed players to start a multiplayer match solo
[*] Fixed bug that could break the text of upgrade cards
[*] Fixed bug where end-game metrics would be different for each player
[*] Fixed bug that could prevent collectible items from being attracted
[/list]

[b]New Content:[/b]

[list]
[*] New Zombie Enemies:[list]
    [*] Runner Zombie: fragile but fast, runs towards the player to bite them.
    [*] Explosive Zombie: slow, explodes when close to the player.
    [*] Tank Zombie: strong and fast, has a medium-range attack in a small area in front of it.[/list]
[*] New collectible item: Magnet (Rare) - Attracts all collectible items on the map.
[*] New card available: Elemental Affinity - increases damage dealt by elements.
[*] New weapon: Spiked Shield: Blocks projectiles, deals damage on contact with enemies, and fires thorns in an area in front when dealing damage.
[*] New car mechanic: Drifting (L2 / Shift) - Holding the button makes the car drift in the current direction, allowing for quick rotation.
[*] Consumable cards now have rarity, adding much more variety to the match and offering more options for improvements.
[*] Players and enemies now have health bars! If you don't like them, they can be individually removed in the options menu.
[/list]
    

[b]Changes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Locators for objectives now appear in front of the HUDs.
[*] Increased the time after the end of the match and added a screen to confirm the end of the game, to improve the sense of confusion when winning or losing.
[*] Enemies have a percentage chance to appear in each region, allowing for rarer enemies.
[*] Upon completing a dungeon, all collected items are automatically attracted.
[*] Dungeon rewards are chosen before returning to the map.
[*] Health is recovered when leveling up.
[*] New icon at the feet of quest enemies, to facilitate visualization.
[*] Completing a quest or dungeon always guarantees a weapon or a weapon upgrade.
[*] New card visuals for equipment, to differentiate from consumable cards.
[*] Leveling up grants a short period of invulnerability and pushes all nearby enemies.
[*] When taking damage, the green health bar moves instantly and a new red bar follows slowly, to help visualize received damage.
[*] Feedback when copying the room code.
[*] Visual improvements on the upgrade selection cards to identify the selected card.
[*] Slight increase in the texts that appear above the vehicle when collecting a consumable.
[*] New healing effect when collecting a healing consumable or leveling up.
[*] New font for player names during the match.
[*] New attribute: Elemental Affinity: Increases damage dealt by elements.
[/list]
